goal: Fall back to block policy fee estimates whenever the mempool policy estimator is not ready
Prevent severe fee underestimation when the mempool is sparse or emptied after restart
agreement: Strong support for falling back to block policy when mempool policy is not ready (stickies-v, willcl-ark)
Urges dropping commits falling back on sparse mempools to avoid fee overestimation (davidgumberg)
Downstream LDK reports confirm mempool estimates fail while block estimates work (instagibbs)
Verified by testing the fallback behavior (tankyleo)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it prevents severe fee underestimation or errors when mempool estimates are unavailable
Avoids fee floor underestimation when mempools are empty, sparse, or reloading
Directly resolves active failures reported downstream by LDK
